svg.title: T cell (immunological synapse)
svg.desc: T cell engaging an antigen-presenting cell at an immunological synapse, with T-cell receptor-peptide-MHC pairs in the centre, adhesion molecules at the rim and the T-cell centrosome polarised toward the contact.
